subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS

Cc: Priyanka Singh <priyanka.singh@fintechco.com>

Subject: Follow-up: Hosted API sizing / token volumes

Thanks again for the call today \u0012 good conversation. As promised, sharing a quick snapshot of our expected usage and a couple of follow-ups so we can get a ballpark on hosted API pricing. Attachment: FintechCo_usage_snapshot.csv (see totals tab).

Quick summary of our ask / numbers:
- Expected monthly token volume (aggregate across product): ~150,000,000 tokens / month (150M)
- Sample request profile: avg input+output ~600 tokens, 60% of calls are streaming responses
- Peak TPS observed in internal tests: ~40 TPS sustained for short bursts (2-5 min), baseline 5-8 TPS
- Pattern: heavy batch of background calls overnight for batch scoring (~40M tokens nightly) + steady daytime traffic

Two questions we need help on for procurement: 
1) Can you provide a target $/1M tokens band for hosted API (we're evaluating $/1M target for budgeting)?
2) Any recommended guardrails for peak TPS and burst credits for hosted customers at this scale?

Budget-wise we're currently modelling $1k-$4k/month for the hosted API line (flexible depending on unit economics).

Next steps: if you can provide a simple ballpark (range) and any follow-up clarifying questions we can answer, that'd be great. Also happy to schedule a short follow-up demo with infra/SEs.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director of Product, FintechCo

- Peak: ~40 TPS bursts, baseline 5-8 TPS

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up: Hosted API sizing / token volumes

Jordan \u0012 thanks for the details and the file. Quick ballpark while we prep a formal estimate (attachment: redwood_pricing_ballpark.pdf):

Assumptions: 150M tokens/month total (includes nightly batch), peak ~40 TPS short bursts, avg request 600 tokens. Using hosted API with a mid-sized open model family.

Ballpark pricing (hosted API) \u0012 rough ranges
- Conservative (higher-end models, full streaming): $14 - $18 per 1M tokens => $2,100 - $2,700 / month for 150M
- Typical (open-mid models, some streaming): $10 - $14 per 1M tokens => $1,500 - $2,100 / month
- Aggressive (quantized/discounted commitment): $6 - $10 per 1M tokens => $900 - $1,500 / month

Notes:
- Peak TPS matters for concurrency and latency SLOs; for 40 TPS bursts we recommend prewarming and short burst credits. That typically adds a small fixed monthly fee if you need guaranteed burst capacity (we'll include options).
- Streaming increases cost slightly because of longer-lived connections and token emission patterns \u0012 we'll show both streaming and non-streaming numbers in the estimate.

Action items: 
- Marissa: preparing the formal estimate (range table) and two recommended configs (standard hosted + burst-guarantee) by Friday EOD.
- Alex: can you comment here on whether 60% streaming materially increases required replica count for 40 TPS spikes (cc'd).

Jordan \u0012 does the "Typical" band ($10-$14 /1M) match the unit economics you were hoping for? If you have a target $/1M we can tune the suggested configs to hit it (tradeoffs: latency / throughput / cache aggressiveness).

Ben Carter
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199
